scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run typecheck && npm run test:architecture && npm run test:unit:coverage
scripts.test:architecture: npm run architecture:compile && node --test .architecture-build/*.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .architecture-build; exit $status
scripts.i18n:extract-js: mkdir -p languages && rm -f languages/.yamabiko-table-reorder-js.pot languages/.i18n-messages.js && babel src/messages.ts --out-file languages/.i18n-messages.js --config-file ./babel.i18n.config.js
scripts.i18n:pot: npm run i18n:extract-js && wp i18n make-pot . languages/yamabiko-table-reorder.pot --domain=yamabiko-table-reorder --include=yamabiko-table-reorder.php --skip-js --merge=languages/.yamabiko-table-reorder-js.pot && rm -f languages/.yamabiko-table-reorder-js.pot languages/.i18n-messages.js
scripts.i18n:json: wp i18n make-json languages/yamabiko-table-reorder-ja.po languages --domain=yamabiko-table-reorder --extensions=ts,tsx --use-map='{"src/messages.ts":"build/index.js"}' --no-purge && prettier --write "languages/*.json"
scripts.i18n: npm run i18n:pot && npm run i18n:po && npm run i18n:json
